title: Taqwa Ethics Audit & Anti-Gharar Engine
description: Implements automated Islamic jurisprudence guardrails, prompt/AST Riba and gambling detection, and pre-payment staging preview validation.
keyDecisions: FAIL-CLOSED TAQWA AUDIT. Any prompt or generated code containing Riba interest calculations or prohibited concepts is rejected immediately with explicit alternative guidance (e.g. Murabaha/Mudarabah).
MANDATORY STAGING PREVIEW (ANTI-GHARAR). Deployment checkout requires a pre-validated, unexpired staging URL with explicit RAM/CPU resource limits.
